highlights.title: SIN and Business Number
highlights.text: Local identifier workbenches split body, prefixes, local vocabulary, and official boundaries.

highlights.title: GST/HST number and payments
highlights.text: Tax, banking, payment reference, and reconciliation tools keep browser-only checks separate from regulated status.

highlights.title: Developer debugging
highlights.text: CSV, JSON, API, privacy, OCR, locale, and data-quality tools expose field breakdown and developer payloads.

developerNotes.title: No official claims
developerNotes.text: Offline checks never prove official Canada registry, tax, bank, postal, identity, or legal status.

developerNotes.title: Field breakdown required
developerNotes.text: Every tool must keep named slices visible because they are the primary debugging surface.

developerNotes.title: Same-country links
developerNotes.text: Related workbenches stay inside /canada/ unless a comparison route is explicitly designed.

commonMistakes.title: Treating syntax as status
commonMistakes.text: A passing shape check is not an official lookup result.

commonMistakes.title: Logging raw personal data
commonMistakes.text: Use masked previews for tickets, logs, analytics, and screenshots.

commonMistakes.title: Ignoring local separators
commonMistakes.text: Use Dot (.) and Comma (,) rules before API normalization.

commonMistakes.title: Mixing jurisdictions
commonMistakes.text: Do not reuse non-Canadian examples, fallback copy, or related links in this suite.

officialSources.title: provincial/federal business registry
officialSources.text: Official business registry lookup remains the source of truth for Canada.

officialSources.title: GST/HST number

officialSources.title: PIPEDA / provincial privacy
officialSources.text: Privacy obligations require legal/process review outside browser-only diagnostics.
